name: GW AI Website Builder
author: GravityWrite

sections.description:
AI Website Builder by Gravity Write is a revolutionary WordPress plugin that simplifies website creation using artificial intelligence. Ideal for small business owners, bloggers, and designers, this plugin helps build professional, responsive websites — no coding required.

Seamlessly integrated with Elementor, the plugin offers intelligent layout suggestions, a wide range of pre-designed templates, and real-time customization tools. Build your website visually and effortlessly.

Key Features

  • AI-Driven Design: Instantly generate layouts and content tailored to your brand.
  • Elementor Integration: Customize templates using Elementor’s intuitive interface.
  • Live Preview: Visualize design updates in real-time.
  • Brand Personalization: Edit logos, fonts, colors, and contact info with ease.
  • Template Library: Choose from industry-focused, pre-built templates.
  • Mobile-Responsive: Fully responsive websites for all devices.
  • SEO-Optimized: Automatically follows SEO best practices.

Why Choose AI Website Builder?

Whether you’re launching a blog, portfolio, or business site, this plugin combines the speed of AI with the flexibility of visual editing — delivering professional results fast.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following external services to function correctly:

  1. GravityWrite API

    • Purpose: Provides AI-powered website content generation, template fetching, and plugin activation verification.
    • Data Sent:
      • Site domain (for license and activation checks)
      • User-entered text prompts (used to generate AI content)
      • Basic usage statistics (e.g., word count, number of imports)
    • When Data Is Sent: Only when specific plugin operations are performed (e.g., generating AI content, templates import, activation).
    • Provider: GravityWrite (Website Learners Private Limited)
    • Terms & Privacy:
      • Terms & Conditions: https://gravitywrite.com/legal/terms-and-conditions
      • Privacy Policy: https://gravitywrite.com/legal/privacy-policy

  2. Plugin Asset Server (plugin.mywpsite.org)

    • Purpose: Hosts essential frontend assets (JavaScript and CSS) needed for the plugin’s UI.
    • Data Sent: No personal or sensitive data; only static assets are served.
    • When Accessed: Every time the plugin loads its UI in WordPress admin or frontend.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Download the Plugin
    Visit: https://gravitywrite.com/ai-website-builder

  2. Upload via WordPress Dashboard

    • Go to Plugins > Add New
    • Click Upload Plugin
    • Select the downloaded ZIP file

  3. Install & Activate

    • Click Install Now
    • Then click Activate

  4. Start Building

    • Go to Gravity Write > AI Website Builder in the admin menu
    • Follow the guided steps to build your website
sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge?

No, it’s a complete no-code builder.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes, it integrates seamlessly with Elementor’s interface.

Can I change branding elements like logos and colors?

Yes, you can fully personalize logos, fonts, colors, and more.

Does it support live preview?

Absolutely — all design changes are reflected in real-time.

Is it SEO-friendly?

Yes, generated websites are optimized for search engines.

Are the templates mobile responsive?

Yes, all designs are mobile-friendly by default.
